title: Rafi Mohammad v. Uttar Pradesh Power Corporation Limited and Others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Manoj Kumar Gupta and Prashant Kumar, JJ.
disposition: Theft recovery citation quashed; no final assessment order
headnote: A recovery citation for electricity dues in a theft case, issued when no final assessment order existed, was held illegal and quashed. The licensee was left at liberty to pass a fresh order strictly under the procedure in the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The writ was disposed of.
facts: Rafi Mohammad petitioned the Allahabad High Court against Uttar Pradesh Power Corporation Limited and three others, challenging a recovery citation for electricity dues said to arise from theft. On 21 February 2023 the Court permitted service on respondents 1 to 3 and listed the matter. On 28 February 2023 counsel reported service on the Department's counsel, whose name was directed to be shown in the cause list. On 3 March 2023 that counsel appeared and stated that the citation had issued although no final assessment order existed.

reusable_constructions.construction: A recovery citation for electricity dues in a theft case is illegal, and liable to be quashed, when no final assessment order is in existence.
After such a citation is quashed, the licensee may pass a fresh order only by following the procedure prescribed in the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

holding_units.topic: Theft recovery citation without a final assessment order
holding_units.holding: A recovery citation for electricity dues in a theft case, issued although no final assessment order exists, is illegal and is quashed. The licensee may pass a fresh order only in strict accordance with the procedure prescribed under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

principle_tags.application: The Department conceded that the theft-dues recovery citation had issued with no final assessment order in existence. The Court treated that absence as rendering the citation illegal, quashed it, and reserved only a fresh order under the Supply Code procedure.

not_decided.point: Whether theft was established and what sum, if any, is recoverable on a fresh assessment
not_decided.note: The Court did not try the theft allegation or quantify dues. It quashed the citation and left the licensee to pass a fresh order under the Supply Code.
